cards.title: Picking your 2 abilities
cards.text: You bring a weapon and 2 abilities: Spawn, Dash or Burst. When do you pick them?
cards.why: Burst becomes an ability and Laser a weapon next; this decides how the third ability gets in.

options.label: Run start
options.text: Pick a weapon and 2 abilities before each run.

options.label: Settings
options.text: Chosen in the pause menu, like the weapon now.

options.label: Found in runs
options.text: Start with one; the second is found in a run.
